policy.purpose: Canonical public genetics library for DTF Genetics. Each line receives a dedicated /seeds/<slug>/ page and one or more source-controlled strain-card visuals.
policy.commerceSource: WooCommerce product pages control current price, stock, pack quantity, fulfillment and transaction details.
policy.claimsStandard: Treat packaging traits and flowering windows as breeding direction or planning observations, not guarantees.
policy.unknownLineage: Do not invent parentage. Publish lineage as unverified until a controlled breeding record exists.
policy.mediaSource: Public, permanent Shopify CDN copies of the user-supplied reviewed strain-card files are used only as origin URLs for WordPress media ingestion; Google Drive IDs remain provenance/backups.
policy.byteIdentity: WordPress ingestion validates image type and expected dimensions; original source SHA-256 and byte length remain provenance.

lines.name: Berry Blue
lines.summary: Berry Blue is presented as a berry-forward DTF line with blue and purple visual direction, sweet berry aroma direction, and dense resinous flower structure.

releaseCards.altText: Berry Blue F2 Regular DTF Genetics strain card

lines.name: Berry Lemonade
lines.summary: Berry Lemonade is presented as a sweet berry-and-citrus DTF line with colorful fruit-forward presentation and dense resinous flower direction.

releaseCards.altText: Berry Lemonade F1 Regular DTF Genetics strain card

lines.name: Zestberry
lines.summary: Zestberry combines Blue Mango with Cali Orange in a citrus-zest and berry-sweetness direction.
lines.floweringObservation: 8–10 weeks is printed on the reviewed card as a planning range.

releaseCards.altText: Zestberry F1 Regular DTF Genetics strain card

lines.name: Blue Bubblegum
lines.summary: Blue Bubblegum is a DTF breeding line built around sweet fruit and bubblegum aromatic direction and is a parent line used in Mango Bubbles.

releaseCards.altText: Blue Bubblegum F1 Regular DTF Genetics strain card

lines.name: Blue Cali Glue
lines.summary: Blue Cali Glue is presented as a resin-forward, gassy and glue-like DTF line with dense flower structure.

releaseCards.altText: Blue Cali Glue F1 Regular DTF Genetics strain card

lines.name: Blue Mango
lines.summary: Blue Mango is a flagship DTF Genetics project developed through multiple filial generations around vigorous branching, heavy resin, substantial flower structure, and a candy-blueberry-meets-ripe-mango aromatic direction.
breedingDirection: candy blueberry and ripe mango aromatic direction
lines.floweringObservation: An 8–10 week planning window is documented for this project; phenotype and environment can change actual finish time.

lines.name: Blue Mango BX1
